proposals.before: In the intercalary second month, 徐啓元 retired from office. On the wuchen day, 洪承疇管: Left Censor-in-Chief. On the yimao day of the eighth month, 趙開心: Left Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.after: In the intercalary second month, Xu Qiyuan retired from office. On the wuchen day, Hong Chengchou administered the post of Left Censor-in-Chief. On the yimao day of the eighth month, Zhao Kaixin: Left Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.reason: 誤將「洪承疇管」當成姓名；「管」是動詞，表示洪承疇兼管左都御史。

proposals.before: 房可壯 retired from office. On the gengyin day of the first month, 金之俊: Left Censor-in-Chief. In the intercalary sixth month, was transferred. On the wuzi day, 趙開心復: Left Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.after: Fang Kezhuang retired from office. On the gengyin day of the first month, Jin Zhijun: Left Censor-in-Chief. In the intercalary sixth month, was transferred. On the wuzi day, Zhao Kaixin again became Left Censor-in-Chief.
proposals.reason: 「復爲」被誤拆成姓名「趙開心復」；復爲意為 again became。

decisions.reason: s0034 has 博洛自參政改; English must romanize 博洛 as Bolo, and the gloss vice commissioner correctly explains early-Qing 參政/canzheng without inventing content.
s0035 has 尼堪自承政改; romanizing 尼堪 as Nikan and glossing 承政/chengzheng as commissioner restores readable English faithful to the office term.
s0106 is the fused string 趙繼鼎佟國應; these are two separate personal names and must be split and romanized as Zhao Jiding and Tong Guoying.
The literal likewise leaves 趙繼鼎佟國應 fused; separating and romanizing the two names matches the Chinese cell content.
In 戊辰洪承疇管左都御史, 管 is the verb “administered,” not part of a name; the prior “洪承疇管: Left Censor-in-Chief” invents a false name form, and the proposed wording restores the correct sense.
s0134 ends 戊子趙開心復爲左都御史; 復爲 means “again became,” so treating 趙開心復 as a name is wrong, and the proposed “again became Left Censor-in-Chief” matches the Chinese.
s0157’s 納都戶能圖左副都御史 juxtaposes two personal names before the office; fusing them as one referent is incorrect, and separating Naduhu and Nengtu restores the roster reading.

decisions.after: On the yiwei day of the third month, Zhou Lianggong was transferred. On the gengzi day, Cao Rong: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the renchen day of the seventh month, was transferred. On the jihai day, Sun Jianzong: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the ninth month, he was appointed to an outer post. On the jiayin day of the tenth month, Wei Yijie: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
decisions.reason: 九月外用 is an outer/provincial appointment formula, not a personal name, so the prior “外用.” is wrong; drop the proposal’s bracket hedging and render it as “he was appointed to an outer post.”
s0170 is the fused string 魏裔介克星格; these are two officials’ names and must be split as Wei Yijie and Kexingge.
The literal likewise fuses 魏裔介克星格; separating the two romanized names restores the correct reading of the cell.
s0220 has 魏裔介復爲左都御史; 復爲 means “again became,” so “魏裔介復: Left Censor-in-Chief” wrongly absorbs 復 into the name, and the proposed wording corrects it.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0005 shows zh 洪承疇管 was created only by misreading verb 管 as part of the personal name; s0113 supports the name 洪承疇, not 洪承疇管.
Accepted r0006 shows zh 趙開心復 was created only by splitting 復爲 and attaching 復 to the name; s0134 supports 趙開心, with 復爲 as “again became.”
Accepted r0012 shows zh 魏裔介復 was created only by absorbing 復 from 復爲 into the personal name; s0220 supports 魏裔介 alone as the name.
